map.title: Benchmark a richer fingerprint and discovery system

task.title: Capture the current baseline and audited evidence bundle

capture_scope: Static/read-only audit and offline hash/structure/QA verification, not current production attestation. Existing exports reused. No benchmark or inference execution.

classification_semantics.measured: An observation with a stated mechanism; static bytes and historical run metrics have different evidence_quality. Never means factual gold.
classification_semantics.historical: Dated prior artifact/observation, not a current service guarantee.
classification_semantics.proposed: Draft design, planned experiment or unapproved implementation.
classification_semantics.illustrative: Synthetic or explanatory example, not model output or observed demand.
classification_semantics.waived: Explicit gate waiver, never a passing measurement.
classification_semantics.unavailable: No usable audited content at this location.
classification_semantics.superseded: A specific claim replaced by a later source, preserving original artifact.

files.evidence_quality: Current repository guidance; ADR status and scope retained.

integrity_policy.source_snapshots: snapshots/<repository-relative-path>; local_only source bodies deliberately not copied
integrity_policy.self_exclusion: manifest.json excludes itself; SHA256SUMS hashes it plus schema/reports/captures/snapshots. SHA256SUMS and verification.json exclude themselves.
integrity_policy.source_and_copy_validation: validate_bundle.py checks each source file and snapshot against this manifest; inherited export hashes checked separately.
integrity_policy.working_tree: Untracked/modified state and HEAD blob recorded separately; branch alone never identifies draft content.
integrity_policy.semantic_review: Byte capture is exhaustive over selected roots; semantic audit is narrow and explicitly scoped by group/report.
